lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Part 1. You will hear a woman called Kate asking her friend Dan about a canal boat holiday. First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 4.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Dan, you went on a canal boat holiday last summer, didn't you? We're thinking of doing the same thing in the spring.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: We did, yes, and we had a brilliant time. Are you taking the kids?

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Yes, all four of us are going. So which company did you hire the boat from?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: Now, what was it called? Riverside Boats? No, sorry, Riverside is the other company at the same marina. Ours was Meadow Boats. They were really helpful.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Meadow Boats. I'll look them up tonight. Do the holidays always start on a Saturday? That's what I've seen on most websites.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: A lot of companies do that, but with Meadow you can start on a Friday or a Monday. We went on a Monday, and it was much quieter at the marina.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: That's useful. And is it very expensive? I've got no idea what to expect.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: It depends on the time of year. We paid about nine hundred and fifty pounds for the week, but that was in September, which is cheaper.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: We'd be going in April, over Easter.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: Then for a boat for four people, I'd say about eleven hundred pounds. If you wanted a bigger boat, it's more like thirteen hundred, but you really won't need that.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: That's not bad for a whole week, for all of us. Does that include the fuel?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: Yes, the fuel's included, and so is parking for your car at the marina. And before you set off, someone from the company gives you a lesson on how to steer the boat. That's free.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Oh, good. I was a bit worried about that part. Is it a long lesson?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: About half an hour. They also send you a video to watch before you go, but to be honest, the lesson was what really helped.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 5 to 10.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: So, have you got any advice for us? We've never done anything like this before.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: Well, the boats are all a similar size, but some of them only have one bathroom. Ours did, and with four people it was a bit of a problem in the mornings. So I'd ask for a boat with a second bathroom.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Good idea. What about things to pack? Do we need to bring life jackets for the children?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: No, the company provides those, and they check them before you leave. But do take some gloves. You're pulling ropes all day, and they're really rough on your hands.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Gloves. I'd never have thought of that. And what about the locks? I've heard they can be tricky.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: They're not difficult, but they are slow. The guidebook says each lock takes about ten minutes, but for beginners it's more like twenty. So don't plan to go too far in one day.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Right. And can you keep going in the evening if you're behind?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: No, you're not allowed to move the boat in the dark. The rule is that you have to be tied up by sunset, so you need to keep an eye on the time.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: OK. And were there any good places to visit along the way?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: Lots. The best one was Lyddon Mill. It's an old flour mill, and now it's a museum where children can grind their own flour.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Sorry, how do you spell that?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: It's L-Y-D-D-O-N.
lines.say: It's L, Y, double D, O, N.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Lyddon Mill. And is there anywhere nice to eat out? I don't really want to cook every night.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: In the village of Ashby there are two pubs right by the canal. The Swan has live music at the weekends, which some people like, but it gets very noisy.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: We preferred the Anchor. It's got a big garden next to the water, so the kids could play while we ate.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: That sounds perfect. Is the food good there?

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: Really good, and not too expensive either. Just get there early, especially on a Saturday, because it fills up fast in the holidays. And you can moor the boat right outside, which is handy.

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Brilliant. Thanks, Dan, this has been really helpful. I'll ring Meadow Boats tomorrow and see what they've got for Easter.

lines.speaker: DAN
lines.text: No problem. Let me know how you get on, and if you've got any more questions, just give me a call.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That is the end of Part 1.

groups.instructions: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.title: Canal boat holiday
lines: Booking: the hire company is called {1} Boats
Booking: holidays can start on a Friday or a {2}
Booking: a boat for four people at Easter costs about £{3} for a week
Booking: fuel and car parking are included, and a free {4} on steering is given before you leave
Advice: ask for a boat which has more than one {5}
Advice: bring {6} for handling the ropes
Advice: allow about {7} minutes to get through each lock
Advice: the boat must be moored before {8}
Advice: if there is time, visit {9} Mill, which has a museum
Advice: in Ashby, eat at the pub with a {10} beside the canal

1.why: Dan first says 'Riverside', then corrects himself: Riverside is the other company. Their company was Meadow Boats.
1.trap: 'Riverside Boats' is a wrong guess that Dan corrects at once. When a speaker says 'No, sorry', the answer usually comes next.

evidence.quote: with Meadow you can start on a Friday or a Monday

2.why: With Meadow Boats a holiday can start on a Friday or a Monday. Friday is already in the notes, so the gap is Monday.
2.trap: Saturday is what most other companies do. Kate mentions it, but it is not the answer for Meadow.

evidence.quote: for a boat for four people, I'd say about eleven hundred pounds

3.why: Kate is going at Easter, in April. For that time Dan says a boat for four costs about eleven hundred pounds. The pound sign is already in the notes, so write only the number.
3.trap: Three prices are mentioned. £950 was Dan's price in September, and £1,300 is for a bigger boat.

evidence.quote: someone from the company gives you a lesson on how to steer the boat

pairs: on how to steer the boat
4.why: Before you set off, the company gives you a free lesson on steering.
4.trap: The company also sends a video, but you watch that at home before you go. The free thing given before you leave is the lesson.

evidence.quote: So I'd ask for a boat with a second bathroom.

5.why: Dan's boat had only one bathroom, which was a problem for four people. He says to ask for a boat with a second bathroom.

6.why: Dan says to take gloves because you pull ropes all day and they hurt your hands.
6.trap: Life jackets are mentioned first, but the company provides them, so you do not need to bring them.

evidence.quote: for beginners it's more like twenty

7.why: The guidebook says ten minutes, but Dan says beginners need about twenty minutes for each lock.
7.trap: Ten minutes is the guidebook's time. Dan says it is not right for beginners like Kate's family.

evidence.quote: you have to be tied up by sunset

8.why: You cannot move the boat in the dark, so it must be tied up by sunset.

pairs: an old flour mill, and now it's a museum
9.why: Dan spells the name of the mill: L, Y, double D, O, N. 'Double D' means two Ds.

evidence.quote: It's got a big garden next to the water

10.why: Dan's family liked the Anchor because it has a big garden next to the water.
10.trap: The Swan is the first pub mentioned. It has live music, not a garden, and Dan says it is too noisy.
